title: nan
authors: Jurevičius R.; Marcinkevičius V.; Šeibokas J.
key_contribution: Presents a robust GNSS-denied UAV localization method combining particle filter and visual odometry with map-relative matching, demonstrating superior accuracy over ORB-SLAM2 on simulated aerial imagery.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
